_what: The local MCP bridge (computer/local-mcp-bridge.mjs): a listener on this computer's own loopback address that speaks MCP over HTTP (JSON-RPC by POST, the server's event stream by GET) and passes each request to the person's account /mcp with the person's key, which stays in the bridge and never reaches the client. A local AI client is configured with the bridge's address and its token; it needs no key of its own. `host` is the only address it binds. The `token` is made once, kept in `token_file` (mode 600) and compared in constant time; every request without it is refused before anything else is read or answered, the health of the bridge included. A request whose Host is not one of `hosts`, or that carries an Origin not in `origins`, is refused, so a web page cannot reach it. `port` 0 takes a free port, written to `port_file`. `tools.allow` is null (every tool the account offers) or a list of tool names the bridge will list and call; it is an opt-in narrowing, open by default.

words.unauthorized: Send the bridge token as a Bearer token.
words.bad_host: This address is not served here.
words.bad_origin: A web page may not use this bridge.
words.too_big: That request is larger than the bridge takes.
words.tool_not_offered: This bridge does not offer the tool {tool}.
words.needs_key: The bridge needs the account key from the helper that started it.
words.on: The local MCP bridge is on at {url}. Its token is in {file}.
words.off: The local MCP bridge is off.
words.already: The local MCP bridge is already on at {url}.
